annotations.title: Fetch a page through a proxy

description: Fetches a web page through the signed-in account's AeonProxy residential (default) or mobile proxy from the chosen country, region or city, and returns the HTTP status, the final URL and the content as Markdown (default), plain text or HTML. Use it to see a page as people in another country see it (local prices, search results, ads, availability) or when a site refuses data-center IPs. One GET request, redirects followed, no JavaScript is run, binary files are not returned. It uses the account's paid traffic: each result reports the KB used. It goes through the AeonProxy proxy gateway (https://aeonproxy.com/docs); set-up and limits: https://aeonproxy.com/docs/setup/mcp-server.

country.description: two-letter country code of the exit IP; leave out for any country

max_chars.description: longest content to return; the rest is cut

product.description: residential (home IPs) or mobile (4G/5G carrier IPs)

session_id.description: reuse the same exit IP for 10 minutes across calls by passing the same id; leave out for a fresh IP

name: fetch_via_proxy
